tez: BJ has a conditional standalone thesis: its 4.61% earnings yield is above the reported peer median of 2.94%, while revenue grew 9.9% year over year and the report shows strong mechanical financial-quality diagnostics. However, the thesis depends on cash conversion recovering, because first-quarter free cash flow was negative, operating cash flow declined materially, and liquidity/refinancing indicators are weak. The current valuation is defensible only if earnings growth converts back into sustainable free cash flow without further liquidity deterioration.

belirleyici_veriler.aciklama: The earnings yield is above the reported 2.94% peer median, providing relative valuation support.
Revenue grew 9.9% year over year, above the report's favorable growth threshold.
Current-quarter free cash flow was negative, versus positive comparable-period free cash flow.
The current ratio is below both 1.0x and the reported 0.93x peer median.
The parent-attributed TTM free-cash-flow proxy yield is low and relies on a disclosed proxy methodology.

tezi_bozacak_kosullar: Operating cash flow and free cash flow do not recover by 2026-Q2.
Liquidity weakens further, including a current ratio below 0.70.
Revenue growth fails to translate into improved gross margin and cash conversion.
Refinancing pressure intensifies without evidence of sufficient liquidity.
belirsizlik: No forward estimates are embedded in the report.
No structured debt, operating-lease, or finance-lease maturity schedule was extracted.
Issuer-reported EBITDA and issuer-reported net debt are unavailable.
The TTM free-cash-flow numerator is a parent-attribution proxy rather than a GAAP-reported parent free-cash-flow measure.
No post-period financial adjustment is estimated despite a 93-day price-to-financial-cut-off gap.
